acquisition: Greedy maximization of sum_i sqrt(track_length_i) max_selected exp(-distance_i_selected / image-only bandwidth)
geometry: the same query-specific normalized PCD + real part-colour descriptors as colour-cohort inference

query_allocation: exact same fixed per-query quotas and eligible length>=3 as existing COV/UNIFORM
teacher: same frozen Qwen CROP, same anchors and prompts; new real GPU observations, no GT in selection
controls: same classical learner under COV and UNIFORM
no graph / PCD-only / colour-only / stronger unary
scope: video-stream teacher causal, current video transductive; all data development
caveats: facility coverage is a surrogate, not guaranteed target recall
short but true targets may receive lower weight
higher coverage must still pass actual RMOT evaluation
